title: Arcane Index Reference: First Steps
summary: Use the Arcane Index as the first stop for magic records and safe next actions.

blocks.title: Open The Browser
blocks.body: Start with the Index categories before testing a magic item. The right page should name the system, warning state, and related records.

blocks.title: Search Narrowly
blocks.body: Search by relic, spell, ritual, curse, machine, landmark, or boss gate. A narrow search usually beats scrolling every arcane page.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first win is finding a page, following one relation, and returning to play with a specific next action.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
